title: Regular singular genitive: -n
summary: Add -n to these vowel-ending words: talo (“house”) → talon.
objectives: Add -n to these vowel-ending words: talo (“house”) → talon.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: The genitive is a case form. It can link a word to an owner or another noun. Here you practise the word form; later lessons show its uses in sentences.
Add -n to these vowel-ending words. Keep the existing final vowel; -n does not change with vowel harmony.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Keep talo and add -n: talo + n = talon.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
